final.justification: No construction in any searched source gives an extension that preserves unique extension for all pure states and joins exactly one prescribed pair. The crossed-product precedents (AW04, FH17) need a global automorphism and separability, and the global version of the property is open as CF22 Q8.2. Downgrade pressure: CF22 Sec. 8, which is in L, explicitly suggests a 'partial crossed product' amalgamation for the same goal. The ingredients (Ueda HNN, AAP excision, AW cross-excision, AWW free-product estimates) are all in L. The eureka content is the choice of peaking-projection algebras with matched traces as the HNN data, together with the peak-transfer/trace-null endpoint analysis that makes it work for every old pure state.

provenance_flag.explanation: 297 cites Tanaka2026 (arXiv:2609.26930v1, 2026-09-22) as an earlier ZFC construction with a faithful trace. Tanaka2026's AI-use statement says the construction and proofs were developed predominantly by OpenAI ChatGPT, preceded by an AI-assisted Brief Report (2026-09-21) and a MathlibAnnex Lean release (2026-09-20). 297 uses no result from it, and its route (HNN bridge, closed sub-iterations, c^+ recursion) is absent from Tanaka. One device, transporting trace-2^-n CAR projections by KOS automorphisms (C5), is shared. So: model-produced precedent for the theorem and for C5, not builds-on. Both works come from OpenAI models within four days, so a shared lineage cannot be excluded. Web searches for Naimark with ChatGPT/GPT-5/OpenAI/AI-assisted found only Tanaka2026 and its companion pages. The pre-2026 neighbours (AW04, FH17, AWW10, CF22, Ueda) are human.

common.prompt_template: Problem: Construct in ZFC (no diamond, no CH) a unital simple infinite-dimensional C*-algebra with a faithful tracial state and a unique irreducible representation up to equivalence. Library: [L- digest]. Established results you may use: [non-hidden items, verbatim]. [directed: Strategy: ...] Propose the single most useful new construction, lemma or definition, stated precisely, with a proof sketch.

P-C1.hide: T16, I20, L09, L07, I05's role as HNN data, P11's use with abelian D_i, and everything downstream that names the bridge (T21, L22, T25, I25). Keep Ueda's HNN (in L) and AAP/AW excision.
P-C1.equivalence_criterion: HIT: an extension obtained by adjoining a unitary that implements a partial isomorphism between two small (abelian / peaking or excising) subalgebras attached to the two states, built as a reduced HNN or amalgamated free product with a trace or expectation killing reduced words, and claimed to give unique extension for ALL pure states with only the designated join. PARTIAL: CF22-style amalgamation A *_B (B x Z) with B separable, or an HNN extension without the all-states unique-extension claim. MISS: crossed product by a global automorphism (AW04/FH17), forcing, or diamond-type guessing.
P-C1.pivot: Report the hit rate separately for arms L- and L-minusCF8; the gap measures the contribution of CF22 Q8.1.
